crossRefs.note: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts…
The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
“You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.
Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast…
Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to Yahweh three times per year, burning…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.
translations.bsb: He observed the daily requirement for offerings according to the commandment of Moses for Sabbaths, New Moons, and the three annual appointed feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles.
translations.kjv: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
translations.asv: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
